description:
Guided setup for a new or empty HubSpot portal. Captures sales goals and imports initial contacts to get the user started quickly.
Use when the user wants help getting started inside a new or empty HubSpot portal — "onboard me to HubSpot", "I'm new to HubSpot", "my portal is empty", "configure my HubSpot", "where do I start in HubSpot". Not for "set me up" or installing and connecting tools: that is hackathon-setup.
